name: Woori Bank
verdict: Woori Bank, a wholly owned subsidiary of Korea Exchange-listed Woori Financial Group, which is fully privatised (the Korea Deposit Insurance Corporation's last stake was cancelled in 2024). Nothing found.
note: Back sponsor (above the number) and right-sleeve '우리은행 WON' sponsor-patch sponsor of Pohang Steelers' 2026 home kit: the K League's 2026-02-10 kit-launch article says the new '우리은행 WON' patch of sponsor Woori Bank goes on the right sleeve, and the club store's 2026 home-shirt full-marking renders show '우리은행' above the back number. Rating note: ownership chain documented (see claims); no state stake, and no court, regulator, UN or major-NGO human-rights finding against Woori Bank or Woori Financial Group found (quick check 2026-09-30).
